intro: Candles of Beckoning is a brief task centered around salvaging specialized ritual tapers discovered in Tirisfal Glades. These eerie tallow candles are steeped in dark practices and recovered from a crate on Gunther's Retreat, Gunther Arcanus's island in Brightwater Lake.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
